applicationName.description: Optional explicit name for the rendered ArgoCD Application. Defaults to a name derived from clusterName + destination, so several Postgres clusters can land on one target cluster without colliding.

destination.description: Argo destination for the rendered Application. Provide `server` (cluster URL) or `name` (registered cluster name) — at least one required. Template prefers `name` when both are set. `namespace` is required and has no good default: a CNPG Cluster belongs in the namespace of the app that consumes it, not in the operator's namespace.

clusterName.description: Name of the Cluster CR (upstream nameOverride + fullnameOverride). Renaming creates a new Cluster and orphans the old PVC.

postgresqlVersion.description: Major PostgreSQL version, as a string.

storageClass.description: Empty string = the target cluster's default StorageClass.

owner.description: Owner role for the application database. Upstream runs this value through `tpl`, so Go-template braces are forbidden here.

appSecretName.description: Existing kubernetes.io/basic-auth Secret with the owner's credentials. Empty = CNPG generates `<clusterName>-app`. Emitted to the upstream chart only when non-empty.

monitoring.description: Prometheus Operator integration for the PostgreSQL pods. `podMonitor` and `prometheusRule` are gated by `enabled`.

backups.description: Backups are off by default; the upstream chart warns that recovery will not be possible. Configure the object-store target through extraValues.

extraValues.description: Deep-merged on top of the computed valuesObject passed to the upstream chart.
